what_this_is: Curated first-party snapshot of AERO_BENCH source, configuration, tests, docs and build recipes for the monorepo folder aero-bench/ of ZhiweiWei-NAMI/AeroAgentSim. It is a copy, not a git merge: it carries NO AERO_BENCH commit history.

snapshot.source_commit_subject: Integrate frontend performance and stack work with pending platform changes

dirty_file_provenance.untracked_breakdown_note: All 1339 dirty paths are untracked evidence/dataset working files under validation/, frontend/public/ and frontend/validation/. None is part of this export except the host/ example, whose files were also untracked in the source workspace and are published here deliberately as the P02 host-mount example.
dirty_file_provenance.host_example_provenance: validation/p02-parcel-host/host/ (untracked working tree in the source workspace, files dated 2026-10-05, copied unmodified except the two sanitizations declared under sanitizations)

Design-reference images, asset category as above; not needed to run the code.

exclusions.reason: Run logs/evidence, raw datasets and working-session records are excluded by policy; no known redistribution rights for generated datasets.

screenshot_status.gallery_note: All screenshots under host/screenshots/ show authored demo/fixture evidence. They are NOT evidence of a real BENCH or Atlas run, and none is a visual-acceptance claim.
